title: Drachma and Lost Coin
summary: A drachma was a silver coin, and the lost coin parable uses household searching to picture joy over recovery.
background: The woman’s careful search shows the value of what was lost and the joy of finding it. The setting is domestic and ordinary, but the meaning is deeply spiritual.
teachingHelp: Use the lost coin background to help people see patient seeking and heavenly joy over repentance.
